name: the-claude-factory
description: Production-grade Claude Code plugins that automate and optimize everyday workflows: skills, agents, hooks, MCP and LSP servers, and more.

plugins.name: bash-lsp-intelligence
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code bash-language-server for Bash and POSIX shell scripts, formats and checks every script Claude edits with shfmt and ShellCheck using your own configuration, and teaches Claude to trace sourced files and same-named functions before a rename.

plugins.name: block-no-verify
plugins.description: Blocks Claude's git commands that skip commit hooks or signing (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, commit.gpgsign=false), so your quality gates always run.

plugins.name: github-operations
plugins.description: Carries a GitHub pull request from open to merge, cleans up a Git repository without losing work, and brings the GitHub MCP server with it.

plugins.name: hook-engineering
plugins.description: Designs, writes, audits and debugs Claude Code hooks end to end: the event and configuration that decide when a hook runs, the input and output contract that decides what it does, prompt, agent and background hooks, workspace trust and security, and how mods interact with hooks, checked against the current docs and changelog.

plugins.name: mods-engineering
plugins.description: Designs, builds, reviews, tests and debugs Claude Code mods, checking every interface against the current mod docs and the type declarations your own Claude Code build writes.

plugins.name: plugin-evals
plugins.description: Makes Claude an expert in Claude Code plugin evals: designs suites that prove what a plugin adds, writes cases, graders and mocks, runs and gates them in CI, and reads the results, always checked against the CLI and docs you have today.

plugins.name: plugin-test-bench
plugins.description: Proves your Claude Code plugin works the way your users receive it: installs a copy in a throwaway config, checks it loads, runs your eval suite against that copy, and reviews your eval cases so they measure what the plugin adds.

plugins.name: project-maintainer
plugins.description: Keeps a project's memory in its .claude folder: decisions recorded as ADRs, technical debt tracked in a ledger, and a handoff that carries each session's state to the next one.

plugins.name: prompt-writer
plugins.description: Turns a goal, idea or draft into one copy-ready prompt tuned to the target Claude model and effort: it clarifies intent, checks current official facts and recommends the setup to run it with.

plugins.name: python-lsp-intelligence
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code the basedpyright language server for Python, checks every Python file Claude edits with ruff and basedpyright using your own configuration, and teaches Claude to navigate by symbol, resolve aliases and imports, and fix findings without suppressing them.

plugins.name: skill-diagnostics
plugins.description: Audits Claude skills for best-practice conformance, portability and whether a model can run them without guessing, with file-and-line evidence and one verdict.

plugins.name: svelte-development
plugins.description: Writes, reviews and migrates Svelte 5 and SvelteKit 3 code by current practice, checking every change against the official Svelte docs and autofixer, the Svelte language server and your project's own check.

plugins.name: tool-ledger
plugins.description: Lists every tool call of the session in a live panel: what ran, on what, whether Claude or a subagent made it, and whether it finished, failed or was denied.

plugins.name: turn-meter
plugins.description: Shows how long each turn took, how many tools it used in the main thread and in subagents, and the tokens it spent, in a band above the prompt, and alerts you when a long turn ends.

plugins.name: typescript6-lsp-intelligence
plugins.description: Connects your TypeScript 6 language server to Claude Code, type-checks every file Claude edits with your own TypeScript under a strictest policy, and teaches Claude to find the program that owns a file and fix compiler findings without unsafe assertions or suppressions.

plugins.name: typescript7-lsp-intelligence
plugins.description: Connects the native TypeScript 7 language server to Claude Code, type-checks every file Claude edits with your own native TypeScript 7 compiler under a strictest policy, and teaches Claude to find the program that owns a file and fix compiler findings without unsafe assertions or suppressions.
